attempt: SELECT action_id FROM public.gregale_outbound_action_attempts WHERE namespace=$1 AND request_id=$2::uuid
bind: INSERT INTO public.gregale_outbound_action_attempts(namespace,request_id,action_id) VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING action_id
run: SELECT input_sha256 FROM public.gregale_outbound_action_runs WHERE action_id=$1 AND run_id=$2::uuid
register_run: INSERT INTO public.gregale_outbound_action_runs(action_id,run_id,input_sha256) VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING input_sha256
load: SELECT intent,version,outcome FROM public.gregale_outbound_actions WHERE identity=$1
reserve: INSERT INTO public.gregale_outbound_actions(identity,intent,outcome,state) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb,'{"state":"prepared","code":"prepared"}'::jsonb,'prepared') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING intent,version,outcome
claim: UPDATE public.gregale_outbound_actions SET state='unknown',outcome='{"state":"unknown","code":"dispatch_unconfirmed"}'::jsonb,version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE identity=$1 AND version=$2 AND state='prepared' RETURNING intent,version,outcome
observe: UPDATE public.gregale_outbound_actions SET state=$4,outcome=$3::jsonb,version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE identity=$1 AND version=$2 AND state IN ('unknown','pending') RETURNING intent,version,outcome
cancel: UPDATE public.gregale_outbound_actions SET state='cancelled',outcome='{"state":"cancelled","code":"cancelled_before_dispatch"}'::jsonb,version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE identity=$1 AND version=$2 AND state='prepared' RETURNING intent,version,outcome
